mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_logs ( event_type, user_id, session_id, product_id, search_keyword, page_url, error_message, created_at ) VALUES ( #{eventType}, #{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{productId}, #{searchKeyword}, #{pageUrl}, #{errorMessage}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO event_statistics ( event_type, statistic_date, event_count ) VALUES ( #{eventType}, CURDATE(), 1 )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE event_count = event_count + 1
